name: Live Lyrics
author: Iliya Brook
description: Live synchronized lyrics in your bar: character-by-character reveal, word-by-word karaoke, beat alignment grid, and loudness glow. A port of the angelOS lyrics bar and engine by MixaDoDs (MIT).

barWidget.description: Synchronized live lyrics for current MPRIS track

schema.label: Word-by-word karaoke
schema.description: Animate word by word when available in LRC/sync data.

schema.label: Beat sync
schema.description: Align word timings to detected audio beat grid (osu-beats).

schema.label: Text glow effect
schema.description: Glow mode: level (volume level) or off.

schema.label: Preferred MPRIS player
schema.description: Substring of player identity/desktop name to prefer.

schema.label: What sits left of the line
schema.description: Album cover from the player, or the note icon.

schema.label: Opacity (%)
schema.description: How solid the lyric line sits in the bar.

schema.label: Max line width (px)
schema.description: How wide a lyric line may get before it glides sideways.
